node.title: E22 residual-profile generating function
node.statement: For fixed dyadic M_i<M_j, before imposing lower-scale minimality, canonical scale-M_i data raw-admissible at M_j are counted exactly by the product generating function that chooses selected M_i-fibers by complete or incomplete M_j-parent and then chooses canonical tails in unselected M_i-fibers subject to b+M_i*r<M_j.
node.attack_surface: finite product enumeration over coarse parents and unselected fine fibers
node.falsifier: a canonical scale-M_i support counted by the product formula with the wrong residual statistic or tail multiplicity
